name: The Great Outdoors

angles.text: As a priest, you may find your calling in sacred sanctuaries and chapels. Yet life on the road calls for practical survival skills alongside prayers and blessings.

faq.answer: Eric is a seasoned traveler who teaches newcomers how to survive in the wilderness. He welcomes you beside his campfire and shares advice for life beyond city walls.
Resting beside Eric's campfire gives you the Boosted Rest effect. It helps you recover and prepare for the trials ahead, away from the elements.
faq.q: What is the Boosted Rest buff?

faq.answer: Camp fixtures are practical structures or tools for specific tradeskills that you can set up in the wild. Trainers in nearby settlements explain how your profession lets you establish a working camp.
Sitting beside Eric's campfire gives you time to pause, warm up, and hear his guidance on wilderness survival. Resting there lets you gain the full benefit of shelter outdoors.
faq.q: Why do you need to sit near Eric's campfire?

faq.answer: After learning to rest at camp, Eric suggests visiting the nearby village. Local trainers can teach you a tradeskill, then show you how to make camp fixtures suited to your craft.
faq.q: Where should an adventurer go after completing this lesson?

faq.answer: Eric welcomes passing adventurers with a restless spirit and a readiness to seek fortune and glory across the world. His wilderness guidance can help you leave safety and venture into the open wilds.
faq.q: Who is this survival lesson intended for?

sections.body: Beyond settled places, ambition and a weapon or holy symbol are not enough. You need to know how to rest amid the elements. Eric has traveled far, and he welcomes you beside his campfire. There, he teaches why proper rest matters before you face the wilds.
sections.title: Lessons of the Wild

sections.body: A campfire begins a useful campsite for a long journey. Once you have learned how to recover in the wild, visit tradeskill trainers in nearby settlements. They can teach you to make camp fixtures for your trade. Then your craft can support your travels wherever the road leads.
sections.title: From Campfire to Craft

summary: Eric waits by his campfire to teach travelers how to rest in the wild.
